name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Fixed Instagram Reel and video download failure: now streams full multiplexed high-definition MP4 directly without corrupt container issues.
Bulletproof download engine with automatic Range-based connection resume and retry if mobile networks stutter.
Universal video validation: safely accepts all valid progressive MP4, WebM, and TS formats without false negative failures.
Properly resets download speed and remaining ETA indicators when tasks complete or encounter network issues.
